name: Photon Capital Advisors Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1983, Photon Capital Advisors 
Ltd is in the business of investment and financial services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PCAL is an investment company. It invests in long-term investments and distributes the dividends. The company is presently only passively managing existing cash. It is evaluating several business opportunities at the 
moment.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 47.5 days to 14.6 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -11.0% over last 3 years.
